extDescription.message: Set the current tab's volume from 0 to 600% with a plain linear gain, including WebRTC calls (BigBlueButton, Jitsi). Voice normalizer, mono, mute, per-site memory.

boostNote.message: Above 100%, a loud source may sound harsh: lower the value until it is clean.

enabledHelp.message: Turn the extension on or off for this site

offNote.message: Off for this site: the sound plays untouched. Reload the tab to release it completely.

normalizeHelp.message: Evens out loud and quiet voices (video calls). Pauses and background noise are not boosted.

monoHelp.message: Mix left and right into both ears

privateNote.message: Private window: changes apply to this tab only and are not saved.

meterIdle.message: Level shown while the tab's sound is processed

optionsIntro.message: Sites with their own settings. Sites not listed use the defaults (100%, Normalize and Mono off).

optionsEmpty.message: No site has its own settings.

shortcutsNote.message: Keyboard shortcuts: Alt+Shift+Up / Down (volume), Alt+Shift+M (mute). Change them in about:addons, gear icon, Manage Extension Shortcuts.
